content:
Here are a few simple and polite ways to acknowledge an email:

1. **Short and professional:**

> Dear [Name],  
> Thank you for your email. I have received it and will get back to you shortly.  
> Best regards,  
> [Your Name]

2. **If you just want to confirm receipt:**

> Hi [Name],  
> I’m writing to confirm I have received your email.  
> Thanks,  
> [Your Name]

3. **If you want to acknowledge and indicate action:**

> Hello [Name],  
> Thank you for your message. I have noted the information and will review it. I’ll update you soon.  
> Best,  
> [Your Name]

If you want, I can help craft a more specific reply if you share the context of the email you received.
